main_text.p: [Syriac/Hebrew word] Syr. Adverb. Plus, magis, potius, potissimū, vehementer, vehementius, multò magis.
[Syriac word] Syr. Abundantia, Luc. 12.15. Excellentia, præcellentia, præstantia, ad Rom. 3.1.
[Hebrew word], [Hebrew word] Ch. & Syr. Utilitas, commodum, emolumentum, lucrum. Plur. [Syriac word] Tit. 1.7.

main_text.p: [Hebrew word] Ch. & Syr. Hic, huc, illuc: [Hebrew word] Idem, & nonnunquam cum interposito [Hebrew word] Huc, [Hebrew word] Huc & illuc: Exo. 2.12. & aliter, [Hebrew words] Itinere diei hinc, & itinere diei illinc, Num. 11.31. [Hebrew word] Hinc: geminatum in eâdem sententia, est Hinc, Inde, ut Exod. 17.12. 2. Sam. 2.13.
